solutions.explanation:
Use the common-logarithm convention: \(\log\) has base \(10\), and its argument requires \(x>0\). The power and quotient rules let us combine the left side into one logarithm:
\[
\log x-5\log3
=\log x-\log(3^5)
=\log\left(\frac{x}{243}\right).
\]
Thus \(\log(x/243)=-2\). By the definition of a base-10 logarithm,
\[
\frac{x}{243}=10^{-2}=\frac1{100},
\qquad
x=\frac{243}{100}=2.43.
\]
These transformations are reversible for \(x>0\), and the resulting value is positive. Therefore \(x=2.43\), choice C.
solutions.title: Combine the logarithms
